== Signed Gold Leader In Gold 1 (Reddit, 2025) ==

Reasoning for the [[Kendrick Summers#Signed cards|Signed cards]] entry ([[:File:Signed Gold Leader In Gold 1 (Reddit, 2025).jpg]]). Confidence: confirmed.
* Source: [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/1n61y5w/does_anyone_recognize_these_signatures/ "Does anyone recognize these signatures?"], r/starwarsccg, posted by _Sols_Golden_Curse_ on 1 September 2025 (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027185849/https://swccg.com/snapshots/reddit/r-starwarsccg-1n61y5w.html Internet Archive]). One photo of three cards the poster got "in a big eBay set my parents bought for me circa 2001 or so": [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]], [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]] and [[Red Leader In Red 1]].
* The silver-ink signature across the art can be read as "Kendrick Summers". [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]] is one of the two [[Rebel Leader Packs]] cards, and the article lists Summers as the [[Squadron Members|Squadron]] Gold Leader.
* Replies in the thread: ro23dart, who wrote that he worked at Decipher around 1999–2000, "Gold Leader is Kendrick Summers, that was his nickname at Decipher"; jbhelfrich, "The second one is Kendrick, though I thought that Gold Leader was Kevin ForgottenLastName".
* A reply by JerseyMuscle17 is now deleted on Reddit and shows as [deleted] in the preserved copy; its text survives in the PullPush Reddit archive (comment id nbwv25w): "Gold Leader in Gold 1 is definitely Kendrick Summers, who was Gold 1 for the Squadron program. I don't remember who Red Leader was". The same reply named "Juz Pakes (sp?)" for the Obi-Wan card.
* The same three cards, with the signatures in the same places, were posted on 2 January 2021 by razorh00f as [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/kp6gt5/autographed_cards/ "autographed cards?"] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027185910/https://swccg.com/snapshots/reddit/r-starwarsccg-kp6gt5.html Internet Archive]). The reply by Cringwell there reads: "Left one is Juz Pakes (marketing guy and then co-designer for the episode 1 sets) and right one is Kendrick Summers (one of the marketing guys)". The middle card in that photo is Red Leader In Red 1, which the reply does not name.
[[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 19:05, 27 October 2026 (UTC)

== "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 02:44, 13 November 2026 (UTC)
